'''Kliskud''' was a [[Glottalphib]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pirate/Legends|piratess]] who operated during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After the [[J'feh/Legends|J'feh]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Skijid Vrescot]] acquired the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] for the purposes of distributing [[Tirefin]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]], Vrescot made a deal with Kliskud whereby he allowed her a free reign to strike against [[Starship/Legends|shipping]] in the vicinity of the Wheel in return for her help in combating his rival spice dealers. However, Vrescot reneged on the agreement after Kliskud's activities began to dissuade [[Gambling/Legends|gamblers]] from visiting the Wheel, and the piratess responded by consuming the J'feh.<ref name="VSV" />
